summary.intent: Move Callisto toward v1 by hardening it after two releases (0.12, 0.13) needed recovery: user agreed to tackle A2 and #290 guard gaps, and an adversarial five-agent audit was launched to find further correctness, performance and hardening issues.
summary.outcome: Four of five audits reported; top findings were verified against code and a seven-PR plan drafted. PR 1 (dependency-range rewrite correctness, with a coverage assertion and a floor-raise fix) passed local `just ci` (2221 tests) and was committed and pushed, after the earlier spaced-looks PR #324 was stacked on #323.

repo: The `just ci` wrapper script's background-task 'exit code 0' reflects the wrapper, not the pipeline; the real exit status must be read from the log (saw 100 and 101 before a clean 0).
The harness creates stray `.claude` directories (e.g. under `crates/`) that break the workspace glob and snapshot tests; remove them before running CI.
Worktree guard rejects heredocs and compound commands, so scripts are written to /tmp/claude-501 via Write and run as plain commands.
Snapshot tests are updated with INSTA_UPDATE=always and stray `.snap.new` files deleted.
npm packument is cached for 5 minutes by CDN, no client purge exists; per-version endpoint is uncached.
The release-workflow policy currently allows `id-token: write` only on `build-artifact`; OIDC publishing would need it on `execute` (owner decision).
Credential stripping in `runner.rs` and `registry.rs` is a fixed denylist and must become a per-tool allowlist before OIDC, since `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_*` must reach npm.

code.finding: Floor-raise pass turns LeftAlone on non-dev edges into E319 even when the range already covers the new version (Python bare deps, Cargo `*`, npm `*`/`||`); also raises Peer/Optional floors.
Single-clause `<`/`>` rewrite keeps the operator and yields a range excluding the new version (e.g. `<2.0.0` at 2.0.0); npm.rs:596-608 has the same shape and nothing asserts coverage afterward.
Publish output classifier matches substrings like 'already exists' / '409 conflict' before checking exit status, so a failed publish can be treated as already published.
A2 guard reads only literal versions, so inherited `version.workspace = true` packages are skipped; also capped at 100 commits after reading full history, failing open.
`recheck_trust()` runs about 7 git spawns before every operation, including ones only observed.
Timed subprocess polling sleeps 50ms after the first try_wait, giving every run_quiet/run_with_timeout call a 50ms floor.
`settle_issued` counts only sleeps toward the confirmation window, not observation time, and restarts the window after each confirmed publish.
git log/show calls lack `--no-show-signature`; only `commit_time` passes it, so `log.showSignature=true` corrupts parsing.

workflow: Verify subagent audit findings against the code before relaying them; subagent hand-backs carry no user authority.
Propose recommendations as grouped, independent PRs ordered by mis-release risk, with correctness before performance.
Architecture audit agent repeatedly returned interim notices while waiting on its own background work.

friction: Two releases in a row required recovery, each failure found only by releasing for real.
Full CI first failed on a snapshot test exposing an over-strict coverage rule (caret must cover the pre-release it names), then on stray directories.
Misleading 'exit code 0' background-task notifications masked real CI failures (exits 100, 101).
Classifier refused a scratch-repo git experiment and a PATH-shadowing git wrapper, limiting auditor verification.
Architecture audit never delivered a final report.
open_items: Remaining planned PRs: A2 guard rework, publish classification via observation plus wall-clock deadline, credential hardening, CI packaging dry run and timeouts, performance fixes, smaller fixes.

Unverified audit findings: Python range precision loss, Poetry comment loss, empty changesets never consumed, fixed-group downgrade of an ahead member, changelog BOM/H1 handling, npm spaced ranges becoming Opaque.
npm OIDC trusted publishing needs the policy decision on `id-token: write` for `execute` and real-package verification.
Local tag left after push failure may cause 'Nothing to release' later; only first half traced.
Merge order for the stack: #319 → #320 → #323 → #324; re-trigger CI on release PR #316 before merging.
Empty GitHub release title, private root manifest ignore switch, Intel binary check (no Rosetta), T12 scratch-registry rehearsal (needs credentials), immutable releases setting.
